appDescription: An in-car app that uses vehicle signals to confirm that a car handed over to someone else is parked and returned as expected, guide passengers to exit safely, and check whether a vehicle setting explains an odd vehicle behavior.

function.name: START_VALET_MODE
function.description: Start the designated driver mode that checks whether the car is parked at home and shows the consent screen to the driver.

function.name: START_ESCORT
function.description: Start the escort mode that checks door, seat and seat belt of the rear passenger and guides the passenger to exit on the sidewalk side.

function.name: CHECK_VEHICLE_ODDITY
function.description: Check readable vehicle settings that may explain an odd vehicle behavior the user describes, without diagnosing faults or warning lights.

symptom.description: The odd behavior the user noticed, in the user's words.
